highlights: **Performance:** Less background tracing and Linux process polling, leaner service startup, faster provider-thread reads and PR-status recovery; Codex tools no longer wait for reasoning summaries.

**Dictation:** Opt into cloud transcription through OpenAI, Grok or OpenRouter, alongside local and paired-host options. Voice setup is easier to find, with searchable model choices and remote authorization fixes.

**Threads:** Move scheduled tasks to another thread and delete archived threads from the archive. The default auto-settle interval increases from three to seven days; side chats inherit permission and reasoning settings.
**Mobile:** Less work-row animation overhead, steadier review diffs and filter menus, Android PDF sharing and hardware-keyboard terminal controls, plus clearer scheduled-task and Markdown layouts.

**Agents:** Better ACP questions, typed answers and streamed tool output; safer session recovery and provider updates through mise. Existing agent sessions refresh linking tools, and HTML tools accept file paths.

**Sidebar and themes:** Collapsed sidebars stay collapsed, search ranking improves and remote subagents stay in their lineage. Upstream now supplies local-service themes, replacing our duplicate fork patch.

**Reliability:** Usage-limit auto-resume survives server restarts; required PR reviews remain required until approved. GitLab, Forgejo and Azure DevOps handling improves, and saved screenshots retain full resolution.
